body: Learn More About Our Premium Content | Subscribe To Our Newsletters. # AICPA Engage 2026. **AICPA ENGAGE 2026** takes place **June 8–11, 2026**, at the **ARIA Resort & Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada**. This flagship in-person conference brings together CPAs, firm leaders, and finance professionals for four days of keynotes, interactive workshops, deep-dive sessions, and CPE learning. Attendees will gain practical insights on tax, audit, finance, technology, and leadership, explore the exhibit hall with innovative solutions, and network with peers and industry experts. The in-person experience provides unique access to hands-on training and live discussions that aren’t available online, making it ideal for professionals who want to grow skills, expand networks, and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving profession.
